title: Cadence public trust evidence
description: A sanitized immutable snapshot. Results describe only the bounded checks and scope limits declared here.

source_to_deployment_provenance.meaning: The named source commit produced both named production deployments.
source_to_deployment_provenance.scope_limit: It does not prove that later configuration or provider state is unchanged.

production_dependency_vulnerabilities.meaning: The named commit's production dependencies completed the declared vulnerability check.
production_dependency_vulnerabilities.scope_limit: It covers declared production dependencies and the tool's data at completion time only.

code_scanning.meaning: The named commit completed the repository's configured code-scanning checks.
code_scanning.scope_limit: It covers configured analyzers and rules only and cannot establish the absence of defects.

secret_scanning.meaning: The named commit completed the repository's available secret-scanning check.
secret_scanning.scope_limit: It covers patterns and repository history visible to the configured platform only.

public_artifact_integrity.meaning: The named commit's generated public artifacts match their declared manifests and sanitization rules.
public_artifact_integrity.scope_limit: It covers generated public files, not private operational records or live-route availability.

application_live_route_comparison.meaning: The required application routes on the named production deployment matched the declared route contract.
application_live_route_comparison.scope_limit: It covers the sampled routes and responses at completion time, not every authenticated workflow.

marketing_live_route_comparison.meaning: The required marketing routes on the named production deployment matched the declared route contract.
marketing_live_route_comparison.scope_limit: It covers declared marketing routes at completion time, not every external cache or network path.

hosted_migration_boundary.meaning: The hosted database migration boundary matched the named source commit's migration history.
hosted_migration_boundary.scope_limit: It proves migration-history alignment only, not correctness of user-owned data.

cross_account_rls_isolation.meaning: Disposable accounts could not read or mutate each other's tested rows through ordinary authenticated clients.
cross_account_rls_isolation.scope_limit: It covers only the tested tables and operations at completion time.
